lastChange.note: 2.13: GAP-101 and GAP-111 reopened and resolved, plus GAP-146, GAP-147, GAP-153, GAP-160, GAP-161, GAP-162. .pp-settings can no longer make a third column and the sections that list records take the whole row; a file row is align-items:start with a named .lead cell and an .acts band on its own line when it carries value controls. A window-placed panel is rendered in the nearest open <dialog>. New classes .pp-badges, .pp-setrow.cust, .pp-asset.band, .lead, .acts > .end. Nine new copy keys, customers.printCount gains a zero arm. No token added, renamed or removed.
